Definition: Elishua, the son of King David
BiblicalUsage: Elishua is the son of King David. In 2 Samuel 5:15, the text says "and Elishua." The life behind the name is told on the Elishua People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Elishua matters because God knows His people by name, and Elishua is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
